ShortDescription.Value: Auto-Clean garbage OR use Trash Boss = Self manage trucks + facilities

Publish.LongDescription:
**Magic Garbage + Trash Boss**
✅ OPTION 1, SELF MANAGE - Trash Boss
- 🚚 Keep normal garbage service and trucks driving around, with more control. - Adjust Truck load capacity - useful for bigger cities. - Adjust storage, processing rate, and total trucks per facility. - Extra protection for pickups at the target assigned buildings. - Applies your settings once, then stays idle - best for performance.
### NEW Target Reserve - Works with the game's improved garbage truck routing in game 1.6.2. - Controls how early trucks start skipping small optional pickups before their assigned stop. - Reserve vanilla = 10%; Magic Garbage Recommended = 15%. - Reserve for 20t trucks means 2t is set aside for the actual target building and not used up before the truck gets there.
✅ OPTION 2, AUTO CLEAN - Magic - Clears garbage automatically. - Keeps garbage warning icons away. - Garbage service stays active; cleanup is just very fast.
### Support and feedback - Enjoy! The best way to support the mod is to give it a Like. - Feedback links for GitHub and Discord are on the right of this page.
---
### Compatibility - Safe to remove any time. - Does not use Harmony. - Designed to stay lightweight during normal gameplay.
---
### Bonus status report - Check how your garbage service is doing from Options. - Spot buildings at 7t before garbage warning icons appear. - Compare garbage made, processing capacity, requests, trucks, and facilities. - Status runs only while Options is open. - Detailed Status writes extra information to MagicGarbage.log.
**11+ Languages supported** - Hello, Bonjour, Hallo, Hola, Ciao, 안녕하세요, こんにちは, Olá, Cześć, 你好, 你好, Xin chào
### Credits and Thanks - RiverMochi - author - Thanks to Wayz for inspiration on the original Magical Garbage mod (obsolete) - yenyang - code review, tech advice - Gagaxm, Necko1996 - testing - Gagaxm - truck thumbnail image
Publish.ChangeLog: - Updated for game 1.6.2's improved garbage truck routing. - Replaced Priority Assist with the lightweight Target reserve slider. - Removed Power User and simplified Trash Boss controls. - Rebalanced Recommended settings and improved Status details.
